subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool account IDs infer a single enabled configured account after explicit, default, and bound-account precedence, or should OpenClaw keep requiring an explicit accountId/defaultAccount when the configured default is disabled?
rationale: The change affects documented fallback behavior for existing multi-account configurations, so a maintainer needs to accept the compatibility policy before the linked PR or a replacement branch can land.

options.title: Accept shared resolver policy
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR with a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound account IDs first, then selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

options.title: Keep explicit account selection
options.body: Keep current semantics and document that users must pass accountId or set defaultAccount when the configured default account is disabled.

options.title: Require channel-owned fallback
options.body: Ask for channel-owned behavior if maintainers do not want core to own this fallback policy across message channels.

recommendation.title: Accept shared resolver policy
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR with a shared resolver that preserves explicit/default/bound account IDs first, then selects an enabled configured default or exactly one enabled configured account with clear zero-or-multiple errors.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the prior shared-resolver direction and has accountId/defaultAccount routing history near the policy decision.
